company_news.headline: Why CoreWeave Can't Pay Down Debt From Its Cash
company_news.summary: CoreWeave does not pay for its growth from its own cash, let alone pay down its debt. Over the four quarters to September 2026, it spent $27.6 billion on equipment and buildings. That spending is called capital spending, or capex. The cash its business brought in, called operating cash flow, covered only 26.1% of it.
